source_audit.boundary: Internal consistency of supplied per-observation metric values and the current harness's rounded scenario-bootstrap summaries only. Consistency does not mean good scores. Does not verify scoring ground truth, executed scenarios, source authenticity, provider availability, costs, latency, provenance, independence, or population representativeness. Missing optional metrics remain excluded, not imputed.

warnings: Recorded repeat IDs do not prove independent executions. Copies, selection, shared state, or changed conditions can invalidate future-run interpretations.

method.within_repeat: all supplied criteria must pass together
method.sampling: uniform subsets of k recorded repeats without replacement
method.aggregation: equal-weight mean across all declared scenarios
method.subset_counts: exact integers; fractions are floating-point presentations

boundary: Descriptive enumeration of supplied recorded outcomes, not a release gate, future-run probability, confidence interval, or evidence of production safety. All criteria are tested jointly on the same repeat; any-pass is a contrast, not permission to retry a consequential action. Threshold validity, preregistration, execution authenticity, independence, scoring correctness, and population representativeness are not verified. No repeats or scenarios are dropped. Repeat indices are not timestamps and this is not a consecutive-run analysis. Unlisted metrics are not reviewed. Source hashes bind supplied JSON values, not trusted provenance. Review scenario IDs, metric names, scores, and audit mismatches before sharing.
